Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the government to issue notifications regarding customs duty adjustments in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the government to issue notifications regarding tax adjustments in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The board serves as the consultative body for the government in exercising powers to amend or issue customs and tax notifications.
S.R.O. 125-AIN/2022/73/CUSTOMS: This existing notification is amended to update specific H.S. Code references and refine the wording of a condition relating to the audit of imported materials.
TABLE: The table within the notification is amended to replace specific H.S. Code entries with corrected versions to ensure proper classification of goods.
H.S. Code: The notification replaces specific existing codes with corrected versions to accurately reflect the classifications for imported goods.
